notes.title: Max's Big Bust 2 launches in two weeks!
notes.notes:
That's right, Max is back, and she's even bustier than before! Our new game is called Max's Bigger Bust, and you can check out the Steam page below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432650/Maxs_Big_Bust_2__Maxs_Bigger_Bust/

[previewyoutube=Z36IernRJJ8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Max is back! After Max's partner Brad is transformed in a car bomb explosion and Max is turned into an even bustier babe, Max must team up with a bunch of new and returning weirdos in order to save Axon City from a terrifyingly sexy threat. It's not going to be easy though, Max is going to have to cope with issues like her succubus sister Heather moving back in and refusing to leave despite clearly breaking the terms of Max's lease by holding orgies in the living room. Or the coven of mysterious witches that live in a compound on the outskirts of the city that claim they are definitely not a cult, and Max is turned into a dog at one point. We probably should have mentioned earlier that things are going to get weird.

Chapter 1 and 2 of Max's Bigger Bust will release on Steam in 2 weeks time on October 29th. There's over 4 hours of content in the first release, and we'll release Chapter 3 (which is about 2 hours long) two weeks later.  We'll be releasing a new chapter of the game every 2 weeks at first, but we'll move to a monthly release after the first few updates. Like Max 1, we plan to respond to feedback and update the game based on player feedback. 

We'll post another update closer to launch going over some of the new features and characters in the sequel, but if you've got any questions about what might be in store for Max in this game then leave them below as a comment! Hopefully you're all as excited about Max's Big Bust 2 as we are!

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Our newest game is out now!
notes.notes:
Our newest game, Alluna and Brie, has now launched on Steam! Alluna and Brie is a direct follow up to Max's Big Bust, and takes place three months after the events of that game. Knowledge of magic is now commonplace, and Axon City is repeatedly being attacked by hostile monster girl forces. The city has formed the Magical Response Unit to fight the threat, and the game follows the magical girl Brie as she attempts to save the city.

Unlike Max's Big Bust, Alluna and Brie is an RPG/Life-Sim. There's still visual novel sections, and it's actually our longest game yet at 500,000 words (for comparison, Max was 300,000). But there's also gameplay this time around, including tactical RPG combat and a more in-depth Heart Beats romance system. For more information on the game, check out the link below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003020/Alluna_and_Brie/

If you enjoyed Max's Big Bust, you'll definitely enjoy Alluna and Brie. If you do grab the game, let us know! We're really interested in hearing your feedback.

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Final Story Update Live!
notes.notes:
We did it! The final story update is now live on Steam!

This new chapter adds 15,000 words of new content to the game, as well as a brand new animation scene, the hardest trivia section yet, and even some new characters! The story is now 100% complete, so go check it out!

That being said, we are planning on adding a few new features to the game before we transition out of Early Access. We're planning on overhauling the virtual pet system, and we're also going to look into adding Steam Achievements too. If you find any bugs/errors/typos in the newest version of the game, leave us a message either here, on the discussion boards or email us directly at lachedupgames@gmail.com and we'll get it fixed ahead of the final release.

We're really excited to release this update, and we can't wait to hear what everyone thinks of the finale!

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: New Game on Kickstarter + Waterpark Update Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've got two awesome things to announce!

Our first announcement is we've got a brand new game to unveil! Alluna and Brie and the Tentacle Menace is a turn based RPG/visual novel hybrid, and it's set in Axon City! It's a direct follow up to Max's Big Bust and heaps of characters from MBB will be making an appearance in Alluna and Brie. And yes, Max will get a new haircut (complete with a whole new wardrobe of over a dozen different outfits! Mermaid Max confirmed!). Check it out at the link below!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/336712504/alluna-and-brie-and-the-tentacle-menace

Our second announcement is the Waterpark Update is now live! Follow Max and her friends as they journey to the neighbouring town of Siren's Point for the sole purpose of riding awesome waterslides at Splashdown Mountain! Of course, if you've watched our trailer then you've probably got your suspicions that something significant will be happening to a particular character, but you'll have to play the game to find out more!

Only two more updates until Max's Big Bust is completed! Thanks again to everyone here for making it all possible!

notes.title: Murder Mystery Update Live!
notes.notes:
Max's Big Bust has been updated! This new and exciting instalment follows Max as she pays a visit to LiCastro Manor in the hope of arresting a major player in Axon City's drug trade. However, Max gets caught up in a violent and shocking murder, and it's up to her to find the murderer and solve the case!


This update clocks in at 35,000 words and adds about 2-3 hours worth of content to the game, depending on your reading speed and how long it takes you to solve each of the puzzles. There's three investigation sections in this update, so if you encounter any bugs or errors either leave us a message on the Steam Discussion Boards or send us a message at lachedupgames@gmail.com and we'll fix them right away. 

Enjoy the update, and thanks for playing Max's Big Bust!

notes.title: Dating Update Live!
notes.notes:
The update you've all been waiting for is here! Max's house is ruined and now she's forced to call upon one of five potential love interests to come to her rescue!

Each love interest has a lengthy story section of their own to play through, and it's worth going back and seeing what the other paths have to offer via the Continue option on the main menu, as there's a lot of unique scenes for each character. I know some of you will be very amused by Victoria's route!

If you find any bugs or errors in the update, leave us a message here or on our Steam discussion boards, or alternatively send us a message at lachedupgames@gmail.com.

Enjoy the update, and thanks again for playing Max's Big Bust!

Cheers :)
Lachlan

notes.title: Octopus Milkshake Update Released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've just added a new batch of content to Max's Big Bust!

This update is gameplay focused and features our most complicated and elaborate investigation section yet. Max is once again forced to team up with the mysterious private investigator Ethan, and the two of them are going to have to work together if they're going to solve this case. And just what the hell is going on with those octopus milkshakes?!?

The new content should take you about an hour to play through, and we're planning on releasing a new story update later this week as well. If you encounter any bugs or errors, leave us a message here on Steam or send us an email at lachedupgames@gmail.com

Thanks everyone for being so supportive, and enjoy the new update!

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Coffee Chaos Update Released!
notes.notes:
Police raids? Sexy dream sequences? Surprise visits by your sister?!? All those things and more are now live in the new build of Max's Big Bust!

This new update adds approximately 1-2 hours worth of new content to the game, and follows Max as she's once again teamed up with the sexy and mysterious detective Ethan. Will Max find out where these new synthetic drugs are coming from, and why does she keep feeling so weird around Ethan? And most importantly, how is Max going to remember all of these ridiculous coffee orders?!?

We're really happy with the new content in this update, so have fun and let us know what you think. If you encounter any bugs or errors, send us a message at lachedupgames@gmail.com or post a message in the Steam discussion boards.

Cheers :)
Lach

notes.title: Ethan Update Released!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've just updated Max's Big Bust with new story content!

This update adds two new days, the first of which follows Max as she teams up with a mysterious detective named Ethan, and a second free time day where Max can choose to go to the beach, go shopping or just bum around at a friend's place watching TV. There's a lot of replay value.

All in all we've added just over an hours worth of new content to the game, and we've also fixed some minor bugs and errors from the previous release. 

We've got big things planned for the next update, so stay tuned!

Cheers :)
Lachlan
